newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BORUSSIA DORTMUND V AUXERRE TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BORUSSIA DORTMUND V AUXERRE TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup quarter-final first leg match between Germany's Borussia Dortmund and Auxerre of France:

Dortmund - 1-Stefan Klos; 20-Wolfgang Feiersinger, 16-Martin Kree, 17-Joerg Heinrich; 7-Stefan Reuter, 14-Paul Lambert, 10-Andreas Moeller, 19-Paulo Sousa, 18-Lars Ricken; 13-Karlheinz Riedle, 9-Stephane Chapuisat.

Auxerre - 1-Lionel Charbonnier; 2-Alain Goma, 4-Franck Silvestre, 13-Frederic Danjou, 12-Taribo West; 14-Christian Henna, 6-Philippe Violeau, 7-Sabri Lamouchi, 8-Moussa Saib; 9-Lilian Laslandes, 11-Bernard Diomede.
